floor 2 units by Friday EOD.

Thanks,
R. Osei — Facilities

**Summary:**
The facilities team is performing HVAC maintenance on Building B, Floor 3, this Saturday, October 17, from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM. During this time, the west wing will lose cooling, while the east wing will remain unaffected. 

**Action Required:**
**Yes.** If you have samples in the lab freezers located in the affected area (Floor 3, west wing), you must move them to the Floor 2 freezers by the end of the day this Friday.
